#### **1. Core Innovation**  
The paper introduces **CoT-VLM4Tar**, a novel Vision-Language Model (VLM) specifically designed to detect and resolve traffic anomalies by leveraging chain-of-thought reasoning. This model integrates visual data (e.g., traffic camera footage) with linguistic reasoning to identify the causes of anomalies and propose solutions.

---
